providers.description: Seekho (operated by Keyaro Edutech Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru, India) is a consumer edutainment mobile application delivering short-form learning videos across 50+ categories including stock market investing, spoken English, YouTube monetization, business, cooking, and government-procedure (sarkari) guidance. The platform reports 10 crore+ downloads, 40+ lakh learners, 10,000+ videos, and 250+ verified mentors, and is distributed via the Apple App Store and Google Play. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. As of this enrichment pass, Seekho publishes a consumer marketing site, a blog, and a creator program but exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, or partner API surface.

providers.name: The Mind Company
providers.description: The Mind Company is a consumer mental-fitness company that builds a multi-app platform for cognitive and emotional wellbeing. Its apps include Elevate (cognitive training across memory, vocabulary, math, and more), Balance (personalized meditation for sleep, stress, and focus), and Spark (puzzle-based learning). The company is a portfolio company of Felicis and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. As a direct-to-consumer mobile app business, The Mind Company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its identity, public web properties, and probed security posture.

providers.name: 2U
providers.description: 2U, Inc. is an education technology company, founded in 2008 and headquartered in Lanham, Maryland, that partners with the world's top universities and companies to develop and deliver online education programs — from free open courses to bootcamps, certificates, and credit-bearing master's degrees. In 2021 2U acquired edX, which it operates as its global online learning platform and primary consumer brand, offering thousands of courses across subjects such as artificial intelligence, data science, public health, and business. This profile was seeded from a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio-linked lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline. 2U publishes no first-party developer API on its corporate domain (2u.com); its programmatic and integration surfaces live under the edX / Open edX learning platform, and its engineering work is visible in the 2uinc GitHub organization.

providers.name: Course Hero
providers.description: Course Hero is an online learning platform where students and educators access more than 25 million course-specific study resources — practice problems, study guides, class notes, step-by-step explanations, essays, and lab reports — alongside 24/7 tutoring and AI-assisted study tools. Founded in 2006 by Andrew Grauer at Cornell University and headquartered in Redwood City, California, Course Hero is part of Learneo, a family of learning and productivity brands that also includes QuillBot, Symbolab, LitCharts, CliffsNotes, Scribbr, Bartleby, and LanguageTool. Course Hero exposes only internal, undocumented web APIs (under /api/) that power its consumer web and mobile apps; it publishes no public developer program, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or partner API. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of D1 Capital, Sierra Ventures, and SV Angel.

providers.name: Federal Student Aid
providers.description: The Federal Student Aid (FSA) office of the U.S. Department of Education provides grants, loans, and work-study funds to eligible students enrolled in college or career school. FSA operates StudentAid.gov as the consumer portal for managing federal student loans, completing the FAFSA, and exploring repayment options. FSA does not currently publish a public, open developer API program; aggregate higher education and aid data is redistributed through the Department of Education's open data programs such as the College Scorecard API.

providers.name: Institute of Museum and Library Services
providers.description: The Institute of Museum and Library Services (IMLS) is an independent federal agency that advances, supports, and empowers America's museums, libraries, and related organizations through grantmaking, research, and policy development. IMLS provides data access to grant and museum information through its APIs.

providers.name: Mentimeter
providers.description: Mentimeter is a Swedish audience-engagement and interactive-presentation platform used to run live polls, quizzes, word clouds, ranking, open-ended questions and Q&A during meetings, classrooms and events, with results updating in real time as participants respond from their phones. Founded in Stockholm in 2014, it is used across education and enterprise for interactive presentations and workshops. Mentimeter does not publish a public developer REST API; its extensibility surface is delivered through LMS integrations (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, Brightspace via LTI), presentation add-ins (PowerPoint, Microsoft Teams, Zoom) and SSO, rather than a documented HTTP API. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline against its public developer, security and trust surface.

providers.name: National Institute of Arthritis and Musculoskeletal and Skin Diseases (NIAMS)
providers.description: The National Institute of Arthritis and Musculoskeletal and Skin Diseases (NIAMS) is part of the U.S. National Institutes of Health and supports research into the causes, treatment, and prevention of arthritis and musculoskeletal and skin diseases. NIAMS publishes health information, research resources, and grant data via its website.

providers.name: Physics Wallah
providers.description: Physics Wallah (PW) is India's leading affordable education technology platform, offering live and recorded courses, test series, notes, and doubt-solving for competitive exams (IIT JEE, NEET, GATE, UPSC), government job preparation (SSC, Banking, Railways, Defence), school boards (CBSE, ICSE, and regional boards), and professional certifications (CA, CS, CFA, ACCA). Beyond its flagship pw.live learning app it operates PW Skills for professional upskilling, PW Store for books and study material, CuriousJr for younger grades, and 100+ offline Vidyapeeth and Pathshala centres across 175+ cities. Physics Wallah reached unicorn status in 2022 and serves tens of millions of students. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. Physics Wallah does not publish an official public developer portal or API program; the company's public technology footprint is a set of open-source infrastructure libraries under its tech-pw GitHub org.

providers.name: Tap
providers.description: TAP (Training All People, Inc.) is a next-generation technician training platform for advanced and precision manufacturers. TAP combines online courses (pneumatics, electrical fundamentals, robotics, safety, and semiconductor basics) with immersive VR simulations that replicate real factory equipment and procedures, plus in-simulation quizzes, VR scenario assessments, and workforce skills-profiling dashboards. The platform lets manufacturers evaluate, standardize, and upskill their technician workforce at scale while minimizing disruption to production. Customers include Northrop Grumman, ACC, SUNY, and Dallas College. Backed by 8vc and surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company; TAP currently publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Unitree Robotics
providers.description: Unitree Robotics is a Hangzhou, China-based high-performance robot manufacturer founded in 2016 by Wang Xingxing. The company is a global pioneer in the commercial quadruped (robot dog) market and has expanded into bipedal humanoid robots. Its product line includes the Go1, Go2, and Go2-W quadrupeds for consumers, education, and research; the industrial-grade B1 and B2 quadrupeds for inspection, patrol, and logistics; the H1 full-size humanoid; the G1 humanoid for research and developer experimentation; the R1 humanoid; and the Z1 robotic arm. Unitree also produces in-house components including the L1/L2 LiDAR, hand-grade actuators, and dexterous hands (Dex1-1). Unitree's developer surface is SDK-centric — there is no public REST or gRPC cloud API. Robot control happens on-device over DDS (Data Distribution Service) via the unitree_sdk2 (C++) and unitree_sdk2_python libraries, with high-level message bindings published as unitree_ros and unitree_ros2. The company maintains an active GitHub presence at github.com/unitreerobotics with 46+ public repositories covering SDKs, ROS packages, MuJoCo and Isaac Lab simulation environments, reinforcement learning frameworks (unitree_rl_gym, unitree_rl_lab), teleoperation tooling (xr_teleoperate, kinect_teleoperate, televuer), imitation learning (unitree_lerobot), a vision-language-action model (unifolm-vla), and a Unitree App Store template repo. Documentation lives at support.unitree.com/home/en/developer. Unitree's revenue model is direct robot hardware sales via shop.unitree.com and partner distribution; there is no metered API service tier.

providers.name: Valo Health
providers.description: Valo Health is a Boston-based drug discovery and development company that combines real-world human data, artificial intelligence, advanced causal inference and predictive chemistry to identify and validate therapeutic targets. Its work is organized around two stated capabilities: Human Causal Biology, which applies AI/ML and statistical genetics to large-scale human datasets and validates findings in human tissue, and Closed-Loop Chemistry, which pairs integrated computational modeling with laboratory work to engineer novel small molecules. The company, launched out of Flagship Pioneering and historically associated with its Opal Computational Platform, operates a shared risk-and-reward partnership model with pharmaceutical companies including Novo Nordisk, Merck KGaA, Pfizer and Lundbeck, advancing early-stage R&D while partners lead clinical development. Valo Health is a private biotechnology company that publishes no developer program, no public API and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Kartable
providers.description: Kartable is a French online education platform (edtech) delivering standards-aligned learning for students from primary through secondary school (CE1 to Terminale, ages 6-18). It provides more than 1,000 course summaries, thousands of corrected exercises, and quizzes across 16 subjects including mathematics, French, history, physics, and languages, authored by teachers from the French Education Ministry. Its "Alfa" AI tutor answers questions 24/7, generates custom quizzes from photos of coursework, and guides students through homework, while parents follow progress from a dedicated dashboard. Kartable is a consumer subscription product (from EUR 7.99/month) and does not publish a public developer API. Backed by Partech.

providers.name: Guide Labs
providers.description: Guide Labs is a product-focused AI research company building a new class of inherently interpretable AI systems and foundation models that humans and domain experts can reliably understand, steer, and debug. Its flagship platform, Clarity, is presented as the first inherently interpretable AI platform and surfaces the internal concepts driving a model's decisions, while its Steerling-8B is presented as the first inherently interpretable large language model. The team has published more than two dozen interpretability papers at top machine-learning venues and ships research artifacts such as PRISM training-data prototypes, the FineWeb Concept Atlas, and Atlas for orienting LLM pre-training data. Access to Clarity is available through platform.guidelabs.ai. The company is backed by Initialized Capital.

providers.name: Age of Learning
providers.description: Age of Learning, Inc. is a Glendale, California educational technology company founded in 2007, best known for ABCmouse.com Early Learning Academy, a subscription digital curriculum for children ages 2-8, along with Adventure Academy (ages 8-13) and Mastery-branded school programs. It builds direct-to-consumer and school-facing learning products delivered through web and mobile apps (iOS and Android). Age of Learning does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a consumer edtech provider surfaced from the ICONIQ Capital portfolio, enriched with the public link surface (privacy, terms, support, press, careers) and a domain-security posture probed from public DNS/TLS records.

providers.name: Answers.com
providers.description: Answers.com is a consumer question-and-answer and reference website where visitors ask questions and get instant answers across trivia, science, history, and everyday topics, increasingly blended with AI-personality chat, flashcard makers, study guides, and a math solver. It operates as a content and reference destination rather than a developer platform, and the enrichment pipeline found no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or /.well-known/ discovery surface. This profile is retained as a company record in the API Evangelist network; the only machine-verifiable artifact is a live domain-security probe of the answers.com host.

providers.name: Comento
providers.description: Comento is a South Korean career development and mentoring platform based in Seoul that connects job seekers with working professionals. The service offers a Q&A community and timeline for career discussions, free unlimited mentoring questions answered by industry practitioners, resume and cover letter (자기소개서) review, an AI resume analyzer, interview preparation, and job-focused educational programs including bootcamps (직무부트캠프) and classes for the Korean job market. It also runs corporate training and university affiliation partnerships. Comento operates as a consumer-facing web platform and does not publish a public developer API or documentation surface; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched with the domain and identity signals that are publicly observable.

providers.name: Doomersion
providers.description: Doomersion (doomlingo.ai) is a consumer mobile language-learning app that teaches languages by "doomscrolling" — a vertical, TikTok-style feed of short-form videos in the learner's target language, matched to their level, with clickable explainer subtitles that let you tap any word for an instant translation and grammar note. Founded by Mostafa Afr and backed by Y Combinator, the app ships on iOS and Android. Doomersion exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this record is an API Evangelist network company profile capturing its public web and identity footprint.

providers.name: Marriage Pact
providers.description: Marriage Pact is a matchmaking platform that pairs people using a research-backed compatibility questionnaire, originally built for college campuses and run as periodic matching events across universities. Participants answer a values-and-preferences survey and the service uses the responses to compute and deliver each person their most compatible match. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures, the company operates as a consumer web product; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, documentation portal, or programmatic integration surface.

providers.name: Metagenomi
providers.description: Metagenomi Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: MGX) is an Emeryville, California clinical-stage genetic medicines company that mines metagenomics — DNA sequenced directly from environmental microbial communities — together with machine learning to discover novel gene-editing machinery from otherwise unknown organisms, then engineers it into in vivo genome-editing therapies. Its published toolbox spans five system classes: programmable CRISPR nucleases, ultra-small nucleases that package into a single AAV vector, base editors the company describes as "the smallest CRISPR base editors known", RNA Mediated Integration Systems (RIGS) for template-encoded edits, and CRISPR Associated Transposases (CASTs) for gene integrations exceeding 10,000 base pairs. The company completed its initial public offering on the Nasdaq Global Select Market in February 2024 at $15.00 per share and partners with Ionis Pharmaceuticals on gene-editing programs including ApoC-III, transthyretin (TTR) and angiotensinogen (AGT). Metagenomi sells therapeutics, not software: metagenomi.co is a seven-page Craft CMS marketing site with no developer program, no API, no SDK and no machine-readable specification of any kind. Its GitHub organization is real and first-party but publishes zero public repositories, and its only first-party software package — the `metagenomi` PyPI library of internal Docker helper scripts — has not shipped a release since July 2019.

providers.name: Numerade
providers.description: Numerade is an education technology company that helps students learn STEM subjects through short, expert-created video solutions, step-by-step textbook explanations, and an AI study tutor branded as Ace. Ace responds to typed questions, uploaded notes, quizzes, and worksheets, and can summarize material to help students prepare for exams. The platform spans math, science, and other STEM courses with a large library of instructor-led problem walkthroughs and practice questions. Numerade is a venture-backed consumer learning product and does not currently expose a public developer API, developer portal, or SDK. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of General Catalyst and enriched by probing the public site (2026-07-20).

providers.name: OpenDurian
providers.description: OpenDurian is a Bangkok, Thailand based educational technology company delivering hybrid (online plus offline) learning and test preparation. Its platform offers exam-prep courses for TOEIC, IELTS, TOEFL, TCAS and Thai civil-service exams, language instruction in English, Chinese and Japanese, secondary-school mathematics and science courses, an online bookstore, free English-proficiency assessment tools, and extensive practice-test question banks. The company reports reach in the millions of annual users across its learning ecosystem. It is a consumer-facing edtech product; as of this enrichment pass no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation was found.

providers.name: Openhouse
providers.description: Openhouse is a network of neighborhood children's learning centres in Bangalore and Kolkata, India, describing itself as a "Third Space" for children — neither home nor school, but a sanctuary for curiosity. It runs preschool programs for ages 1-6, a Parent-Toddler Club for ages 1-3, and Excel extracurriculars (robotics, public speaking, music, art and design) for ages 3-5+, built around a learning-by-doing philosophy. The consumer-facing website (openhouse.school, formerly openhouse.study) is a marketing and enrollment surface; the only network-visible technical surface is a private app backend health endpoint at api.openhouse.study. Openhouse was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. It publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Osmo
providers.description: Osmo (Tangible Play) makes hands-on, screen-interactive learning games for iPad and Fire tablet that pair a physical reflector base placed over the device camera with digital games spanning math, coding, spelling, drawing, and problem-solving for children. Backed by Accel and GV, Osmo is a consumer educational-technology brand that sells hardware kits and companion apps direct to families and schools. As of this enrichment pass it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Pingo AI
providers.description: Pingo AI, Inc. is a consumer language-learning application that uses conversational AI to help learners practice speaking across 15 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Italian, Portuguese, and Arabic. Learners hold real-time voice conversations with an adaptive AI tutor and get a transcript and vocabulary list for every session, following personalized learning paths. Pingo is distributed as iOS and Android mobile apps and publishes no public API, SDK, or developer platform. Backed by Matrix Partners.

providers.name: TEDI
providers.description: TEDI (Tecnologia y Educacion Innovadora) is a Latin American EdTech platform delivering professional training for the construction and engineering industries under the motto "Mejores profesionales, mejores paises." It runs 150+ live and recorded courses each month covering BIM, VDC, Lean management, and project management, plus Autodesk/PMI-aligned certifications, an exclusive construction job board, a professional community, the EDI AI learning assistant, and a TEDICOINS rewards system. TEDI reports 50,000+ certified students across 18+ countries with 150+ expert instructors, and is backed by 500 Global. The company operates a consumer-facing web platform (tedivirtual.com / tedicomunidad.com) and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Educative
providers.description: Educative is an online learning platform that provides high-quality, interactive courses for developers of all skill levels. With a focus on practical, hands-on learning, Educative offers courses on a wide range of topics, from programming languages like Python and JavaScript to data structures and algorithms. Each course is created by expert instructors and includes quizzes, coding challenges, and real-world projects to help learners apply their knowledge.

providers.name: Erudifi
providers.description: ErudiFi (ErudiFi Pte. Ltd., formerly Dana Cita Pte. Ltd., a Singapore-registered company) is an education-financing technology company on a mission to expand access to affordable financial services for students across Southeast Asia. It operates two consumer lending platforms: Bukas in the Philippines, which provides secure, integrated tuition installment plans in partnership with top colleges and universities, and Danacita in Indonesia, a peer-to-peer education-financing platform registered with the OJK that funds diploma, bachelor's, master's, and short-course programs. ErudiFi is backed by investors including 500 Global and Helicap. The company maintains a small public GitHub presence (internal tooling, a data-quality checker, and a Danacita UI kit) but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or MCP server.

providers.name: MyARC Fitness
providers.description: MyARC (operated by Vert Analytics Limited) is an all-in-one platform that lets fitness creators and coaches scale their business without writing code. Coaches use MyARC to launch a branded mobile app, automate AI-personalized workout and meal plans for thousands of members at once, run challenges and 1-on-1 coaching, build community, and earn recurring subscription revenue. The consumer-facing MyARC Fitness app ships on iOS and Android with progress tracking and accountability features. As of this profile MyARC exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface — it is a creator-facing SaaS and mobile product, not an API provider. Offices in London, New York, Melbourne, and India.

providers.name: Sentient
providers.description: Sentient (Sentient Labs / Sentient Foundation) is an open-source AI research lab and crypto protocol building Open, Monetizable, and Loyal (OML) artificial general intelligence. Its work spans agent frameworks (ROMA recursive meta-agent, Open Deep Search, EvoSkill agent-skill synthesis), the OML 1.0 model-fingerprinting system for verifiable model ownership and monetization, and the GRID protocol with Sentient Chat as a universal interface for discovering, composing, and coordinating AI artifacts. Backed by Pantera Capital, Sentient publishes peer-reviewed research (NeurIPS, ICML, COLM) and ships its tooling as open-source repositories on GitHub and models on Hugging Face rather than as a hosted commercial REST API.

providers.name: EMERGENCES AI, INC.
providers.description: EMERGENCES AI, INC. (Emergences Labs) builds human competency models, assessment, and training solutions for the AI era, focused on defining the transformative skills whose value compounds rather than erodes as AI advances. Its products include NeoWork, real-world task assessments for recruiting and identifying top performers in AI-native roles and for reskilling; NeoHuman, deliberate-practice training that teaches professionals and students effective human-AI collaboration through real enterprise work; and an expert-curated Data offering of annotated professional workflow trajectories for agent reinforcement learning and domain-specific benchmarks. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes a public website with research, blog, careers, and legal pages, but does not currently expose a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Sounding Board
providers.description: Sounding Board is a leadership development company offering tech-powered coaching and mentoring solutions that help organizations develop dynamic leaders at every level. Its platform pairs software products (Expand, Guide, and Transform) with a global network of ICF/EMCC/IAC/CCE-certified coaches to deliver 1:1 coaching, group coaching, mentoring, and on-demand leadership development. Sounding Board serves technology, professional services, government, education, healthcare, financial services, and retail organizations, and was acquired by BTS in March 2025 to extend end-to-end executive-to-frontline coaching. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and Canaan Partners; no public developer or API surface has been found to date.

providers.name: Zhangmen
providers.description: Zhangmen (掌门1对1 / 掌门教育) is a Shanghai-based online education company offering premium one-on-one and small-group tutoring to K-12 students across China. Its platform pairs students with elite instructors and layers on data-driven, intelligent learning analysis: diagnostic assessment, personalized study plans, real-time classroom monitoring, automated learning reports, and parent progress tracking. Beyond core academic tutoring the company runs quality-education modules spanning public speaking, creative art, programming, and comprehensive/mathematical thinking, along with a piano accompaniment-practice product (zmpeilian.com). The business is a direct-to-consumer web and mobile app play delivered in Simplified Chinese; it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Recess
providers.description: Recess (Recess Academy, recess.gg) is an online school for gifted and neurodivergent students, including learners with ADHD, dyslexia, autism spectrum, and anxiety. It combines core academics, interest-led classes, small-group coworking sessions with an AI tutor, and a daily community hour, with personalized pacing and world-class mentors. Recess is backed by Bloomberg Beta. As of this enrichment pass the company operates a consumer education web application and publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface; the only machine-discoverable surface found is a valid RFC 9116 security.txt with a security contact.

providers.name: Corebridge Financial
providers.description: Corebridge Financial (formerly AIG Life and Retirement) is one of the largest and most established retirement and insurance solutions providers in the United States. Spun off from AIG in September 2022 in the largest IPO of that year, Corebridge provides retirement solutions, life insurance, fixed and variable annuities, and institutional products. The company is a leading retirement plan provider for K-12 schools, healthcare, government, higher education, and other not-for-profit institutions. Corebridge Financial does not currently publish a public developer API; participant and plan sponsor access is provided through dedicated portals.

providers.name: Huron Consulting Group
providers.description: Huron Consulting Group is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Huron Consulting Group API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Praxis Labs
providers.description: Praxis Labs is an AI-powered leadership and human-skills learning platform, surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and acquired by Torch. Its flagship product, Pivotal Practice, uses immersive simulations, personalized AI coaching, and role-play scenarios to build critical management capabilities such as difficult conversations and performance discussions, with behavior-change tracking and ROI analytics. The learning application runs at practice.praxislabs.co behind login and integrates with HR/L&D systems including Workday, Docebo, and Degreed. Praxis Labs is SOC 2 Type 2 certified. No public API, developer portal, or SDK was found during enrichment; this remains a company profile rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Bonum Coaching
providers.description: Bonum Coaching is an enterprise coaching platform based in Latin America that pairs personalized human coaching with technology to develop talent and improve organizational performance. Its offering spans one-to-one executive coaching, group and team coaching, structured mentoring programs, and CLARA, an AI coach-bot for practicing workplace conversations in a safe environment. The company positions itself around democratizing access to coaching, leadership development, talent retention, building a growth culture, and diversity, equity and inclusion, and counts enterprises such as Uber, Davivienda, Farmatodo, and Mi Banco among its clients. Backed by 500 Global, Bonum Coaching is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Calviri
providers.description: Calviri is a Phoenix, Arizona biotechnology company, founded in 2017, that develops multi-cancer diagnostic tests and therapeutic and preventative cancer vaccines for dogs and people. Its science rests on RNA-Error Derived Neoantigens (REDNs) — abnormal proteins thrown off by the error-prone RNA processing of tumor cells — which Calviri builds as peptides on semiconductor chips and then queries against an individual's blood for antibody responses, using those antibodies as sensitive biomarkers of cancer. Its lead product, StageOne Plus, is a canine multi-cancer blood test designed to detect stage 1 disease before signs appear, alongside a pipeline of canine and human therapeutic and preventative vaccines and a preventative-vaccine trial (VACCS) that enrolled 800+ dogs. Calviri is a life-sciences company with no developer program, no product API and no developer portal; the only machine-readable surface on calviri.com is the Wix-platform-generated llms.txt and the anonymous site MCP endpoint it advertises.

providers.name: Career Karma
providers.description: Career Karma is a consumer edtech platform that helps people find and compare career training programs and get matched to the right one based on their goals, learning style, schedule, and budget. Its catalog spans technology paths (coding bootcamps, software engineering, data science, cybersecurity, AI, UX design), skilled trades (CDL truck driving, HVAC, electrical), healthcare, beauty, and sales, alongside rankings, school comparisons, financing guidance (scholarships, deferred tuition, GI Bill), and a resource center of career guides. Backed by GV, Career Karma runs a guided quiz-and-advisor matching experience rather than a public developer API; this profile captures the company identity and the security and link surface probed from its public web properties.

providers.name: Chegg.com
providers.description: Chegg, Inc. is a US-based education technology company that provides direct-to-student learning services on a subscription basis, including homework and expert Q&A help, step-by-step textbook and problem solutions, textbook rental and purchase, online tutoring, writing and citation tools, math and science solvers, and AI-assisted study support. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass Chegg publishes a consumer web and mobile product but no public developer portal, documented API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or MCP server; this profile therefore captures its public web identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Edukita
providers.description: Edukita (PT Edukita Budaya Cinta Belajar) is an Indonesian education company founded during the COVID-19 pandemic by Peter Gumulia and Sean Widjaja on the belief that high-quality education should be accessible to all. It teaches skills that matter through playful but powerful learning, delivering programs online, through six physical learning centers across Greater Jakarta (Bintaro, Bogor, BSD, Depok, Gading Serpong), and blended (Rumah Belajar Edukita). Programs span English with native speakers, early childhood development, Japanese mathematics, and professional upskilling for young students, families, adult learners, and corporate training. Edukita is a portfolio company of 500 Global. It exposes no public developer API surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: NEXT Academy
providers.description: NEXT Academy is a software engineering bootcamp operating across Malaysia and Singapore that trains junior developers through full-time, hands-on coding programs. Its flagship Quantum Degrees cover full-stack web development, frontend, and backend engineering, pairing project-based challenges with personalized mentorship. Founded to help close the region's tech-talent gap, NEXT Academy has produced 2,800+ graduates from 50+ countries, with alumni placed at companies including Google, Uber, AirAsia, Fave, and Mindvalley. It is backed by 500 Global. NEXT Academy publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface as of this profile; its primary digital surfaces are a marketing website and a student learning-management portal at lms.nextacademy.com.

providers.name: Laureate Education
providers.description: Laureate Education, Inc. is a for-profit higher-education network founded in 1989 as Sylvan Learning Systems and renamed Laureate Education in May 2004. At its 2017 IPO peak the company operated more than 200 campuses across 28 countries serving over one million students; it became only the third B Corporation to go public when it listed on NASDAQ (ticker: LAUR) on 1 February 2017. Between 2018 and 2021 Laureate executed one of the largest sector-wide divestiture programs in the history of higher education, exiting Brazil (sold to Ânima Holding for ~$765M), the United States (Walden University sold to Adtalem for $1.48B), Australia / New Zealand (sold to Strategic Education), Chile (Universidad Andrés Bello transferred to Fundación Educación y Cultura in September 2020), Spain, Portugal, Morocco, Turkey, Malaysia, China, Italy, Cyprus and the United Kingdom — returning $1.29B to shareholders in October 2021. After the divestiture cycle Laureate continued as a pure-play Mexico / Peru operator with five remaining institutions and approximately 460,000 students. In May 2024 the company was acquired by an investor group led by the International Finance Corporation (IFC, a member of the World Bank Group) and Sterling Capital, taking Laureate Education private and delisting it from NASDAQ. The company is headquartered at 1000 Brickell Avenue, Suite 715, Miami, FL. Laureate does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, webhook surface, or status page. There is no Laureate Education GitHub organization. This profile therefore captures the corporate surface — institutions, divestiture history, leadership, investor status, news — rather than a programmable interface. The five remaining campus-network institutions each publish their own consumer-facing websites (UVM, UNITEC in Mexico; UPC, UPN, Cibertec in Peru) but none expose machine-readable APIs documented from the parent.

providers.name: Noon Academy
providers.description: Noon Academy (Noon) is a social learning platform where students study alongside their friends in live, teacher-led group classes. Operated by Noon Tech Limited and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, the company serves more than 12 million students and over 100,000 teachers across five countries, primarily in the Middle East and South Asia. Noon is a consumer education product delivered through student and teacher apps and a web experience; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal. This API Evangelist profile was created from a 500 Global portfolio lead and enriched with the company's public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Platformable
providers.description: Platformable provides API governance, open ecosystem intelligence, and consultancy services. Their training resources, dashboards, and tools help organizations build comprehensive, automated, high quality API governance systems and participate in open digital ecosystems including open banking, digital health, and traceability.

providers.name: Calificadas
providers.description: Calificadas is a Mexico-based, AI-powered human development company that combines artificial intelligence, strategic consulting, and training to help organizations and teams adapt to rapid change. Its tagline is "human infrastructure for the era of artificial intelligence." Its flagship product, CUALY (cualy.tech), is an AI-native platform for developing human capabilities through diagnosis, personalization, and continuous AI-driven feedback across communication, leadership, and collaboration, using voice and video analysis and AI coaches, plus organizational dashboards and iOS/Android apps. The company also delivers organizational consulting, leadership training, and adaptive training programs, and counts Coca-Cola FEMSA, ManpowerGroup, and Alsea among its clients. Backed by 500 Global, Calificadas was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, or API documentation; artifacts below reflect its public web and domain-security surface only.

providers.name: Cartwheel Care
providers.description: Cartwheel (Cartwheel Care) is a school-based youth mental health provider that partners with K-12 school districts to deliver rapid-access, evidence-based therapy and psychiatric care to students. Through licensed clinicians it offers individual and group therapy, medication management, and parent guidance, with Care Coordinators contacting families within 24 hours of a school referral and initial appointments typically available within 7-10 days; a course of care generally lasts two to six months. The company is backed by General Catalyst and operates across 25+ school districts in multiple states. Cartwheel publishes no public API or developer surface; its software footprint is a school- and family-facing web application at app.cartwheel.org, hosted on the HIPAA-compliant Aptible platform.

providers.name: Instacoach
providers.description: Instacoach is an AI-powered baseball training app that generates personalized, on-demand workout programs for athletes across hitting, pitching, arm care, fielding, catching, lifting, and mental performance. Programs are built by college and pro athletes and adapt to the user's equipment and goals, with short guided drills, progress tracking, and stat logging. It is delivered as consumer iOS and Android apps plus a web experience, and also offers team training programs for coaches. Sector: consumer sports/fitness technology. Backed by GGV Capital. No public developer API surface was found during enrichment (no api./developer./docs. host, no /.well-known, llms.txt, or OpenAPI).

providers.name: Level AI
providers.description: Level AI (legally Ujwal Inc.) is a Mountain View, California contact center AI company founded in 2019 by Ashish Nagar, a former member of Amazon's Alexa conversational AI team. The company builds LLM-native customer experience intelligence and service automation for enterprise contact centers, with a platform spanning two product surfaces: a CX Delivery suite (AI Virtual Agent, Agent Assist, AgentGPT, Coaching, Manager Assist, Knowledge Bot, Auto Summary, Agent Screen Recording) and a CX Strategy suite (Auto-QA on 100% of interactions, Voice of the Customer theme detection, omnichannel Analytics, iCSAT, AI Workers). The proprietary full-stack AI platform includes Level AI's own ASR/Voice AI and semantic-intelligence layer trained on customer-service data, and is positioned for financial services, insurance, healthcare, retail, banking, and collections operations. Level AI exposes a public REST API for bidirectional data exchange with BI tools and existing contact center stacks, and ships native integrations across telephony, CRM, customer support, workforce management, CX management, communication, learning management, and SSO categories. The company has raised $73.1M to date (Series A 2021, Series B 2022 led by Battery Ventures, Series C $39.4M 2024 led by Adams Street Partners with Cross Creek, Brightloop, Battery Ventures and Eniac Ventures), holds a 4.7/5 rating on G2, and reports customer outcomes including 25% CSAT lift, 45% agent satisfaction improvement, and 90% time savings on manual QA. The Level AI GitHub organization (github.com/Level-AI) exists but is currently empty — there is no public OpenAPI specification, public SDK, or open-source release; the API is documented and credentialed through the customer's tenant of the Level AI platform.

providers.name: Ambition
providers.description: Ambition (theambitionapp.com) is a consumer mobile application that helps teenagers get ready for real life. The app delivers short daily life-skills courses and 30-day simulated virtual internships across careers such as entrepreneurship, sales, game design, nursing, and wealth management, where US middle- and high-school students pick a path, build technical and life skills in about fifteen minutes a day, and can earn gift-card rewards for completing an internship. Ambition ships as native iOS and Android apps ("Ambition - Shape Your Future" / "Learn and Earn"); it is a business-to-consumer product with no public developer API, SDK, or documented integration surface as of this profile. This entry was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched with the real, publicly verifiable identity, legal, and domain-security surface of the product.

providers.name: Get Lighthouse
providers.description: Get Lighthouse (Lighthouse Lessons) is a management-training and leadership-development company that helps managers run better one-on-ones and grow their teams. It offers bite-sized, actionable online management-training programs, including a 1-on-1 Master Class, Managing Up, and the Secret Habits of Senior Leaders, delivered as self-paced solo study and structured team training, alongside a widely-read management and leadership blog. Get Lighthouse is a content and training provider with no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile captures its web identity and domain-security posture. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: MedAll
providers.description: MedAll is a UK-founded healthcare education platform on a mission to make medical education radically accessible. It hosts live and on-demand courses, conferences, workshops, webinars and training sessions for healthcare professionals, students and organisations, and provides event management tooling for registrations, feedback forms, certificates, abstracts, schedules and digital poster halls, alongside CME (continuing medical education), question banks and mobile apps for iOS and Android. The platform is used by clinicians and institutions worldwide. As of this enrichment pass MedAll publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs or webhooks; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture. Backed by Seedcamp.

providers.name: Mos
providers.description: Mos is a consumer fintech that helps students find and win money for college. Founded in 2017 by Tunisian human-rights activist Amira Yahyaoui and backed by Sequoia Capital, Lux Capital and Expa, the company began as a financial-aid application service — FAFSA filing plus human advisor support — then added a fee-free student checking account and debit card in 2021. Mos shut the banking product down and cut staff in 2023 after press and investor scrutiny of its account metrics, refocusing on its original financial-aid business. The live product at mos.com is a scholarship-matching app: students swipe through awards drawn from a database the company describes as $160 billion in available funding, with college financial-planning tools and access to a personal advisor. Sequoia's own company page records Mos as acquired in 2025; the acquirer is not disclosed. Mos ships only an end-user consumer app — it publishes no developer portal, API documentation, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Outsmart College
providers.description: Outsmart (Outsmart Education, Inc.) is an education-technology company rebuilding higher education for the AI era, aiming to make learning smarter, faster, and more engaging than traditional lectures and student debt. The company is currently pre-launch, operating a public waitlist at joinoutsmart.com, and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. As of this profile the company publishes only a marketing site with a legal Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions and does not expose a public developer or API surface. This record was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for ongoing enrichment as any API surface appears.

providers.name: Remind
providers.description: Remind is a K-12 school-home communication platform that lets teachers, schools, and districts message students and families by text, app, email, and voice without exchanging personal phone numbers. The product line includes Remind Chat, a free two-way messaging service used by individual teachers and classrooms, and Remind Hub, a paid district-wide communications platform with administrative controls, SIS integration, delivery analytics, and translation into 90+ languages. Remind reports use in roughly 80% of US public schools and by a majority of US teachers. In November 2023, Santa Barbara-based ParentSquare acquired Remind, and the combined company now operates under the ParentSquare name with Remind Hub continuing for existing district customers and Remind Chat continuing for classroom-level use; Remind Tutoring was discontinued as part of the combination. Remind's only externally documented developer surface is the Share on Remind SDK (the "Remind Share SDK"), a partner program that lets approved third-party content providers embed the Remind composer into their own product, authenticate Remind users via OAuth 2.0, serve shareable content and previews via partner-hosted webhooks, and ship messages back through Remind. The Share SDK is accessed by application through partners@remind.com and the developer console at remind.com/integrations; there is no public self-serve REST API, no published OpenAPI specification, and no general-purpose messaging API for sending Remind messages from third-party systems.

providers.name: Google NotebookLM
providers.description: Google NotebookLM is an AI-powered research and thinking partner that helps users analyze, summarize, and explore sources such as documents, PDFs, web pages, and notes. It leverages Google's Gemini models to ground responses in user-provided source material, generating summaries, study guides, FAQs, and Audio Overviews. NotebookLM does not currently expose a public API; integration with the service is limited to the web interface and supported Google Workspace contexts.

providers.name: Honorlock
providers.description: Honorlock is an online exam proctoring and academic integrity platform for higher education and professional certification. Its primary integration path is LTI 1.3, installed natively into LMS platforms - Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, D2L Brightspace, Open LMS, Docebo, and Intellum - plus publisher platforms such as Pearson, McGraw Hill, and ALEKS via LMS workflows. For assessment platforms that need to embed proctoring outside an LMS, Honorlock offers a partner developer toolkit ("APIs and Elements") documented at docs.honorlock.com - a REST API for provisioning users, courses, exams, authentication tokens, and exam sessions, plus a browser-based Elements/Integration SDK that drives the exam-taker experience (extension verification, session setup, begin/end session). The developer program is sales-gated (contact-sales onboarding); Honorlock does not publish a self-service API key flow, an OpenAPI description, or a public base URL.

providers.name: GreatSchools
providers.description: GreatSchools provides school information, ratings, and quality data via its Developer Hub APIs, including the School Essentials API for school details and the School Quality API for GreatSchools rating bands.

providers.name: Admission Table
providers.description: Admission Table (admissiontable.com) was a study-abroad and overseas-education counseling platform founded in 2013 by Manish Katyan and Duleep Deosthale, offering real-time student counseling, university admissions guidance, scholarships, financing, and online test preparation for the SAT, GRE, GMAT, TOEFL, and IELTS. It was backed by 500 Global, NYU, and Aarin Capital, and was subsequently acquired by Azent Overseas Education. The admissiontable.com domain now permanently redirects (HTTP 301) to azent.com. This entry was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub; enrichment found no public API, developer program, or API documentation on either host, so no API artifacts were produced.

providers.name: BrainCo
providers.description: BrainCo is a Harvard-innovation-lab-founded neurotechnology company building non-invasive brain-computer interface (BCI) hardware and the developer SDKs that surround it. Its consumer and research line centers on wearable EEG headbands - Focus, Focus1 and FocusCalm - that measure attention and stress from brainwave signals for education, wellness and biofeedback, alongside the BrainRobotics neuroprosthetic hand and the Revo (Revo1/Revo2/Revo3) family of dexterous robotic hands for robotics and embodied-AI developers. BrainCo ships first-party SDKs rather than a public REST API: the Crimson SDK for its portable EEG devices (Node.js and native/BLE), the Focus SDK for headband brainwave measurement, and the Revo Hand SDKs (Python and C/C++, distributed on PyPI and GitHub) that speak RS-485, CAN 2.0A/CAN FD, EtherCAT and Protobuf, plus ROS 2 drivers and URDF/MJCF/USD simulation assets. The company is backed by IDG Capital and operates in the healthcare, neurotech, robotics and education-technology sectors.

providers.name: Hudl
providers.description: Hudl is a Lincoln, Nebraska sports performance and analytics technology company founded in 2007. The company started as a video sharing and review platform for high school, college, and professional teams and has grown into a global provider of video capture hardware, performance analysis software, and sports data services. Hudl operates across basketball, baseball, football, ice hockey, rugby, soccer, softball, and volleyball, serving customers from youth clubs through professional leagues. The company's product portfolio spans the core Hudl video platform, Hudl Focus AI-powered capture cameras (Indoor, Outdoor, Flex, Point), Hudl Replay and Hudl Studio for live and tactical analysis, Hudl IQ for American football analytics, Volleymetrics, the Hudl TV livestreaming product, and Hudl Tickets digital ticketing. Through acquisitions Hudl has consolidated several leading performance analysis and football data brands under its umbrella, including Sportscode (performance analysis software), Wyscout (the largest soccer video and stats database), Statsbomb (advanced football analytics), Instat (video and scouting), WIMU and Titan (athlete tracking and wearables), and Signal and ADI. Hudl exposes commercial developer surfaces primarily through Hudl Wyscout (Wyscout Data API, documented as OpenAPI 3.0 at apidocs.wyscout.com, with Database, Stats, Events, and Physical Data packs) and Hudl Statsbomb (the Statsbomb Aggregated API for player-match, player-season, team-match, and team-season data, accessed via the Data Hub, plus the Raw X&Y Tracking Data API and a Wyscout/Statsbomb ID Mapping API). Core Hudl video and Hudl Focus do not publish a public developer API; B2B integrations are sales-mediated. Hudl maintains a public GitHub organization (github.com/hudl) with infrastructure, resilience, and media tooling open source projects (Mjolnir, Fargo, HudlFfmpeg, react-native components), but these are engineering libraries, not product SDKs. Hudl's revenue model is SaaS subscriptions for video, analytics, and data packages, plus camera hardware sales and data licensing.

providers.name: Prellis Biologics
providers.description: Prellis Biologics is a Berkeley, California biotechnology company that discovers fully human antibody therapeutics by combining wet-lab human immunology with machine learning. Its EXIS (Externalized Immune System) platform uses LNO lymph node organoids — 3D tissue printed with holographic two-photon photolithography — to recreate human lymph node biology in vitro, raise true human antibody responses across genetically diverse donors, and feed the resulting sequence and characterization data into generative AI models that predict and optimize candidates in an iterative lab loop. The company sells antibody discovery collaborations and licensed therapeutic programs to pharmaceutical partners rather than software, and publishes no public developer program, API, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Zogo Finance
providers.description: Zogo Finance is a gamified financial education platform (founded 2018, a Techstars portfolio company) that helps banks, credit unions, and other financial institutions engage and educate their customers. Its library of 1,200+ bite-sized financial literacy modules is delivered to end users through an embeddable, white-label SDK that partners drop into their existing digital banking apps and websites, plus a standalone mobile app and desktop web experience. Users earn redeemable points for completing lessons. Zogo is a B2B/enterprise offering distributed via SDK embed and mobile-banking integrations (Q2, NCR, Jack Henry Banno) rather than a public developer API; as of this pass no public API documentation, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal is published.

providers.name: EduAdvisor
providers.description: EduAdvisor is a Malaysian education platform that helps students compare, plan and apply for tertiary education. It provides course and university comparison tools, scholarship matching, study-abroad guidance, and free education counseling, working directly with 100+ universities and colleges in Malaysia and abroad to streamline applications for prospective students. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. EduAdvisor currently operates as a consumer-facing WordPress web platform with no public developer program, API, or documentation surface at the time of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Eleqtron
providers.description: eleQtron GmbH is a German quantum computing hardware company founded in 2020 as a spin-off from the Quantum Optics Department at the University of Siegen by Prof. Dr. Christof Wunderlich, Dr. Michael Johanning (CTO), and Jan Leisse (CEO). Based in Siegen, Germany, eleQtron develops freely programmable, scalable trapped-ion quantum computers built on its proprietary MAGIC (Magnetic Gradient Induced Coupling) technology, which controls qubits with microwaves rather than lasers for higher precision and a clearer path to scaling. The company aims to become a leading provider of quantum computing time for industrial applications across chemicals, pharmaceuticals, automotive, logistics, finance, and machine learning. eleQtron's systems are made accessible to developers through cloud platforms and standard quantum frameworks (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane) rather than a first-party public REST API. Backed by Earlybird Venture Capital.

providers.name: GenM
providers.description: GenM (now operating as Acadium) is a digital marketing career and apprenticeship platform that connects emerging marketers with mentors and businesses. The platform offers free digital marketing courses (SEO, social media, email, and content marketing), hands-on MicroTasks for portfolio building, three-month remote apprenticeships, and Acadium Plus, an eight-week program that leads to full-time hiring. Businesses use Acadium to crowdsource marketing work and mentor emerging talent while growing their operations. GenM was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the company operates a consumer/business web application at app.acadium.com and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Kiko Labs
providers.description: Kiko Labs is a neuroscience-based early-learning company (a 500 Global portfolio company) that builds adaptive brain-training games for children ages 3-7. Its flagship product, Kiko's Thinking Time, is a voice-guided iOS app developed with Harvard and UC Berkeley neuroscientists with support from the US Department of Education and National Science Foundation. The program trains executive functions — working memory, inhibition, focus, and cognitive flexibility — through progressive games, and includes a parent and educator dashboard for tracking skill development. Kiko Labs is a consumer edtech company and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Saxbys Coffee
providers.description: Saxbys is a Philadelphia-headquartered hospitality company founded in 2005 by Nick Bayer that operates a small chain of cafes across the U.S. East Coast and Midwest. The brand is unique for its "Experiential Learning Platform" (E.L.P.) — 100% student-run cafes embedded inside college and university campuses. Each E.L.P. cafe is operated by a Student Cafe Executive Officer (SCEO) who takes full responsibility for running the location while earning paid, experiential learning credit. Saxbys describes itself as "a national education company and For Students, By Students" with a mission to "Make Life Better." Saxbys does not publish a public REST API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, developer portal, or partner integration program. The only public digital surfaces are the marketing website (saxbyscoffee.com), location-specific online ordering powered by BentoBox, a "Saxbys Stories" blog, and a mobile ordering / rewards app. The Saxbys GitHub organization exists but currently holds a single internal inventory-analyzer repository. This apis.yml records the company as a non-API hospitality + education brand for the API Evangelist network catalog.

providers.name: Wukong Education
providers.description: WuKong Education is an online education company headquartered in Auckland, New Zealand that delivers live online classes in Chinese language, math, and English ELA for kids, taught by certified teachers to students across more than 100 countries and regions. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners, it is a consumer edtech business with a student classroom portal but no public developer portal or documented APIs.

providers.name: Campus Apartments
providers.description: Campus Apartments is a privately held student housing developer, owner, and operator headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1958, the company originally served students of the University of Pennsylvania and has grown into one of the largest privately held student housing companies based in the United States, operating over 145 properties across more than 25 states with a portfolio of roughly 70,000 beds. The firm is led by CEO David J. Adelman and operates alongside affiliated brand presence historically associated with the Campus Crest student housing portfolio. Campus Apartments does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI documentation, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Lyra Health
providers.description: Lyra Health is a Burlingame, California enterprise mental health benefits company founded in 2015 that provides employer-sponsored behavioral health care to more than 20 million members across a network of 30,000+ providers in over 200 countries and territories. The platform combines preventive self-care resources, coaching, evidence-based therapy, medication management, family and pediatric services, and specialized acute care delivered through a benefits-administration model sold to large employers and health plans rather than directly to consumers. Lyra's product surface includes the Lyra App for members, the Lyra Empower AI-powered care platform launched in 2025, Centers of Excellence for pediatric mental health and neurodiversity, a manager coaching program, and a clinical-grade AI guide. Customers include Salesforce, Lululemon, Morgan Stanley, Genentech, Starbucks, JE Dunn, VCA, and the School District of Philadelphia, and in March 2026 the company became Workday Wellness's preferred mental health partner. Lyra acquired pediatric and family mental health provider Bend Health in July 2025. Lyra is led by CEO Jennifer Schulz, with Jenny Gonsalves as Chief Product & Technology Officer, Alethea Varra as Chief Clinical Officer, and co-founder Bob Kocher, MD on the board. The company's revenue model is per-member-per- month employer contracts plus utilization-based clinical billing; Lyra does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDK, CLI, or self-service API, and its only public GitHub repository is an internal fork of an unrelated infrastructure module. All employer, member, HRIS/eligibility, SSO, and EHR integrations are negotiated and delivered through the Lyra customer success and implementation teams rather than through a self-serve developer surface.

providers.name: Marble Health
providers.description: Marble Health is a virtual mental-health company providing personalized therapy for K-12 students, delivered through partnerships with schools and school districts and directly to families. Licensed therapists meet with students over video, typically within a few days and with no waitlists, and the service accepts most insurance plans including Medicaid. The platform at app.marblehealth.com handles referrals and intake for school counselors and parents, and Marble Health also runs parent workshops and professional-development training for educators. The company is backed by Costanoa Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Marble Health exposes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable discovery surface (no .well-known documents and no llms.txt); it is a consumer/patient-facing healthtech service rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Nurture
providers.description: Nurture is an EdTech company that turns children's screen time into skill-building experiences through an interactive storytelling app for kids aged 5-7. Built on the thesis that AI is mastering information while human skills — critical thinking, curiosity, empathy, creativity, and resilience — still need to be nurtured, the app delivers character-driven story adventures with practice-based learning, no in-app purchases, no ads, and no endless autoplay. It is COPPA-compliant and features licensed brands such as Care Bears, Crayola, and Pocoyo. Nurture is a consumer mobile product distributed on the iOS App Store, Google Play, and Amazon Appstore, sold as a $36/year subscription with a 7-day free trial. It is a Seedcamp portfolio company. As a consumer application, Nurture publishes no public developer API, SDK, or integration surface; api.nurture.is serves only an internal app backend.

providers.name: United States Botanic Garden
providers.description: The United States Botanic Garden (USBG) is a living museum in Washington, D.C. that showcases a diverse collection of plants from around the world. Established by the U.S. Congress in 1820, the Botanic Garden serves as a resource for education and inspiration, promoting an understanding and appreciation of plants and their importance to the environment and human well-being. The Garden maintains more than 9,500 accessions representing approximately 44,000 plants, managed through its Living Collections database (BG-BASE). The USBG is administered by the Architect of the Capitol and is located adjacent to the U.S. Capitol on the National Mall.

providers.name: Lala
providers.description: Lala (meetlala.io) is an AI content platform for educators that turns recordings of online classes into publishable social media content. Instructors either host lessons natively on Lala's own video-call product or upload an existing recording by file or link, and Lala automatically curates short-form Reels in Instagram and TikTok aspect ratios, assembles packaged courses, and returns a transcription and summary after each class. It is sold in three tiers -- Free, Pro and Enterprise -- metered on upload minutes, video-call participants and Reels generated per class, and is aimed at tutors, music instructors, teacherpreneurs, schools and universities. Lala is a 500 Global portfolio company that came out of the 500 Georgia program. As of July 2026 Lala publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs or machine-readable API description.

providers.name: OCLC
providers.description: The Discovery API allows you to surface both WorldCat and WorldCat Discovery central index data in search results, including: Materials held by your library and ...

providers.name: Study Edge
providers.description: Study Edge is an education technology company that builds online learning, tutoring, and test-preparation platforms for students. Its products deliver on-demand instructional video, live and scheduled study sessions, practice problems, and course-specific study resources, and the company is known for operating statewide math learning platforms such as Algebra Nation / Math Nation. Study Edge is a consumer- and institution-facing learning service rather than a developer platform; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company.

providers.name: Securly
providers.description: Securly is a K-12 student safety company whose platform spans web filtering, device management (MDM), classroom management, and student wellness/self-harm and threat monitoring across the web, email, and cloud drives. Securly is deployed by school districts and integrates with the school technology stack - Google Workspace, Microsoft 365/Entra, Apple School Manager, and Student Information Systems via the OneRoster and rostering standards. Securly's public developer surface is limited and access-gated - it primarily CONSUMES rostering and identity APIs from external systems rather than exposing a documented public developer API. The one provider-exposed API is a credential-gated Securly MDM API used by third-party device/asset systems to pull device inventory and assign or unassign students to devices; its endpoints and base URL are provisioned per tenant and are not publicly documented as a reference.

providers.name: Swing Education
providers.description: Swing Education is a technology-driven substitute teacher staffing marketplace for K-12 schools and districts across the United States. Its vetted platform connects schools and districts with qualified, background-checked substitute teachers and classified staff to cover daily absences, long-term leaves, special education classrooms, and paraprofessional roles. Schools request coverage through an online admin console while substitutes browse and claim assignments through a dedicated app. The company reports a 94% fill rate, an average five-minute fill time, and coverage of more than 6,000 schools. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company profile; the public site exposes no developer/API surface, so this record carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Jefferies Financial Group
providers.description: Jefferies Financial Group is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm providing advisory, capital raising, sales, trading, research, wealth management, and alternative asset management services to clients across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and the Asia-Pacific.

providers.name: Kenbi
providers.description: Kenbi is a German healthcare organization focused on nursing education and workforce development, operating through two divisions. Kenbi Academy delivers continuing professional development for care workers with 100+ ZFU-certified courses recognized by all German health insurers and available nationwide, spanning nursing service management, quality assurance, wound care, and instructor training. Kenbi Campus runs vocational nursing programs in Berlin and Hamburg, including a three-year registered nurse generalist program and an 18-month nursing assistant curriculum. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; no public developer program, API, or documentation surface was found.

providers.name: KromaTiD
providers.description: KromaTiD (KROMASURE) is a Boulder, Colorado single-cell analysis life-science tools and services company founded in 2016, built around its proprietary directional Genomic Hybridization (dGH) platform. dGH probes only the parental strand of DNA, which lets it resolve orientation-specific structural variation — inversions, translocations, insertions and other complex rearrangements — cell by cell, at resolutions that next-generation sequencing and conventional FISH cannot reach. The company sells the KROMASURE platform and the dGH in-Site, dGH SCREEN, kBand and PinPoint product lines as kits and as lab services, aimed at cell and gene therapy developers who need insertional-mutagenesis risk assessment, genotoxicity profiling, edit optimization, starting-material and donor qualification, cell-line characterization and batch-release testing for CMC and FDA IND submissions. Its work has also been used by NASA for spaceflight radiation research. KromaTiD publishes no developer program, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract; its only authenticated surface is a Cognidox-backed customer document portal at my.kromatid.com.

providers.name: TransCrypts
providers.description: TransCrypts is a blockchain-based identity and credential verification platform that lets individuals own, encrypt, and share verified records — employment and income history, background checks, and (with HIPAA certification) health and education credentials — directly with employers, background checkers, and other verifiers. Encrypted data is stored off-chain while cryptographic hashes are anchored on-chain, so users can prove authenticity without exposing personal data. The company reports 5M+ verifications across 4M+ users and 450+ enterprise clients, and connects to HR and payroll systems such as ADP, BambooHR, and Namely. It raised a $15M seed round led by Pantera Capital, with Techstars, Lightspeed Faction, Alpha Edison, Motley Fool Ventures, Mark Cuban, and Protocol Labs participating.

providers.name: Academic Partnerships
providers.description: Academic Partnerships (rebranded as Risepoint in 2024) is an education technology and online program management (OPM) company that partners with more than 100 regional public universities to launch, market, and scale affordable, workforce-focused online degree programs. The company provides operational support services including digital marketing, student enrollment and retention coaching, faculty support, and technology implementation, while curriculum, instruction, and degree conferral remain under university control. Its programs concentrate in high-ROI fields such as nursing, teaching, business, and public service. This profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Babbel
providers.description: Babbel is a Berlin, Germany-based language learning company founded in 2007 by Thomas Holl, Markus Witte, Lorenz Heine, and Toine Diepstraten. It operates one of the world's first online language-learning platforms, offering structured, conversation-focused courses in 14 languages including Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Polish, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Dutch, Turkish, Indonesian, and English. The Babbel product suite includes the core subscription Babbel App with interactive bite-sized lessons, speech recognition, and AI conversation partners; Babbel Live for online classes with certified teachers; Babbel for Business for enterprise language training; Babbel Podcasts and Babbel Magazine for supplemental content; and Babbel Videos on YouTube. The company has sold over 25 million subscriptions and reports that 92% of users improved their proficiency in two months, with effectiveness studies conducted by Michigan State University, Yale University, and CUNY. Babbel maintains an additional office in New York City and is privately held. Babbel's revenue model is direct-to-consumer subscriptions (monthly, annual, lifetime tiers) plus enterprise B2B licensing through Babbel for Business; there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source learner content. The Babbel GitHub organization publishes internal infrastructure tooling (Terraform AWS modules, Puma plugins, OkHttp AWS signing, GitHub Actions) but no consumer-facing API.

providers.name: GeoCat bv
providers.description: GeoCat bv is a Dutch company built around the open-source geospatial stack, and is the primary maintainer of GeoNetwork, the catalogue software that runs a large share of Europe's INSPIRE metadata infrastructure. It sells GeoCat Bridge, GeoCat Live and hosted catalogue services, and runs a public demonstration estate serving both classic OGC web services and a modern OGC API - Features endpoint.

providers.name: GeoSolutions di Giannecchini Simone & C. s.a.s.
providers.description: GeoSolutions is an Italian company and one of the principal maintainers of the open-source geospatial server stack — GeoServer, GeoNetwork, MapStore and GeoNode. It sells enterprise support, deployment and custom development around those projects. Its public demonstration server is a reference OGC deployment, serving classic OGC web services alongside a modern OGC API - Features endpoint.

providers.name: Vedantu
providers.description: Vedantu is an Indian online-learning (edtech) company headquartered in Bangalore that delivers LIVE interactive classes, recorded courses, offline centres, and one-to-one tutoring for school students from Class 1 to 12 and competitive-exam aspirants, covering CBSE, ICSE, IGCSE and major State Boards plus JEE, NEET, CUET and Olympiad preparation, alongside a large free library of NCERT solutions, revision notes, sample papers and study material. Backed by Accel, Vedantu is consumer-facing and operates no public developer API today; its only published integration surface is a legacy External-Integration (EI) kit for institutes on GitHub, though it does publish an llms.txt for agents.

providers.name: Clue (BioWink)
providers.description: Clue, operated by BioWink GmbH in Berlin, Germany, is a science-driven menstrual, ovulation, pregnancy, and reproductive health tracking app with 100M+ downloads across 190+ countries. The product portfolio spans Clue (free tier), Clue Plus (subscription), Clue Conceive, Clue Pregnancy, Clue Perimenopause, and a "Clue (No Period)" mode for non-bleeding hormonal cycles. Clue Connect provides partner sharing. The company contributes anonymized real-world data to academic research partnerships with Stanford, University of Oxford, UC Berkeley, MIT, and the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. Clue is a consumer mobile product; no public developer API or partner API portal has been identified. This entry catalogs the company surface for the API Evangelist index.

providers.name: Pluralis
providers.description: Pluralis Research is a decentralized AI lab pioneering Protocol Learning, a third path between closed proprietary models and open-weight models in which large transformer models are collaboratively pre-trained across many low-bandwidth, geographically distributed consumer GPUs without any single participant holding the full model weights. Its work spans communication-efficient model parallelism, asynchronous pipeline-parallel optimization, and community-owned training runs (Agora, node0), published as research papers at NeurIPS, ICML, and ICLR and as open-source libraries. Pluralis is backed by Union Square Ventures. It exposes research libraries, a participation CLI, and live run dashboards rather than a conventional REST/GraphQL developer API.

providers.name: Ossus
providers.description: Ossus builds AI-native intelligence for cultural institutions, starting with libraries. Its flagship product is Ossus ILS, a modern integrated library system that unifies cataloguing, circulation, acquisitions, analytics, and patron discovery in one interface, with an AI copilot that drafts MARC records, subjects, and classifications for librarian approval. A lighter product, Librar, targets school libraries with fast mobile setup. AI add-ons cover camera-based shelf inventory, vendor comparison for purchasing, and grant finding. Ossus emphasizes privacy-first design: it does not train on or sell customer data and works only with catalogue metadata rather than borrower records. Ossus is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) company based in San Francisco.

providers.name: pandas
providers.description: pandas is a fast, powerful, flexible, and easy to use open source data analysis and manipulation tool, built on top of the Python programming language. It is a Python library that provides DataFrame and Series data structures and analysis tools; pandas itself does not expose an HTTP API, but is widely used to build data APIs alongside frameworks like FastAPI and Flask.

providers.name: Pramaana Labs
providers.description: Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI research lab building the verification layer for high-stakes, mission-critical AI.
